core_obligations: Represent h_U x_{xi', G} F by a scheme V and produce f_1, f_2 : U -> V (proof lines 465-474).
Translate equality of pullbacks of xi_1, xi_2 into equality of f_1 o g and f_2 o g (proof lines 474-479).
Identify h_U x_{xi, F x_G F} F with the scheme V x_{Delta, V x V, (f_1,f_2)} U (proof lines 480-483).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for functors F, G on (Sch/S)_{fppf}^{opp} and a representable transformation a : F -> G, the relative diagonal Delta_{F/G} : F -> F x_G F is representable (source lines 456-462). The proof takes an arbitrary U and a pair xi = (xi_1, xi_2) in (F x_G F)(U), uses representability of a to represent h_U x_{xi',G} F by a scheme V, obtains two morphisms f_1, f_2 : U -> V over U, and shows that the fibre product h_U x_{xi, F x_G F} F is represented by the scheme V x_{Delta, V x V, (f_1,f_2)} U.
